# tone.dad

> Justin Herrera — filmmaker, editor, real estate advisor, and dad based in Morris Plains, NJ (Morris County). tone.dad is his personal hub linking the ventures below.

## About

Justin Herrera (with his wife Stephanie) runs several ventures under the tone.dad brand. The homepage presents four "doors":

1. **Tonemedia** — Wedding films (Justin & Stephanie Herrera). 350+ weddings over 12 years. Past credits include NBC Universal, Taylor Swift ("Blank Space" music video, on-set editor), Katy Perry ("Teenage Dream," ×3), Lady Gaga (×2, as assistant editor), Mariah Carey, and the NY Jets (5 NFL seasons). Website: tonemediastudio.com

2. **Tonehomes** — Real estate advisory for couples, families, and first-time investors in Morris County, New Jersey. Justin and Stephanie paid off $150k in debt and house-hacked their way to 6 units. "Aisle to address" — they help people build slowly rather than close fast. Active since 2021.

3. **Noblepost** — Wedding editing services for other studios. Edits ship under the studio's own name (no watermarks, no Noblepost branding), first draft before your next shoot — for studios who'd rather be behind the lens than living in a timeline. Website: nobleposthouse.com

4. **Learn Video with Tone** — A free 30-minute video coaching call, for anyone from a beginner with a phone to a working filmmaker. Book at cal.com/tonedad/tonebuild

Justin also designs and builds websites (this site, tone.dad, was built with Claude Code).

## Newsletter

"Notes from the Edit Suite" — subscriber-only stories about faith, fatherhood, building things at 4 AM, and the work behind the work. Published via beehiiv at tonedad.beehiiv.com/subscribe.

Stories:
- 001: "Blank Space" — On set at Oheka Castle for the Taylor Swift "Blank Space" music video, September 2014. Live at https://www.tone.dad/notes/001-blank-space
- 002: "She saw a studio. I saw a basement." — The Western Ave house in Morristown: what Stephanie saw in a basement nobody wanted, the two months that made it two homes, and the whole sheet. Live at https://www.tone.dad/notes/002-steph-was-right
- 003: "The freakin' Jets" — Five NFL seasons on retainer, 2010 to 2015 (coming soon)
- 004: "Ten months with Avid DiVa" — Living in Dustin Robertson's Hollywood studio (coming soon)
- 005: "How I got into weddings" — A favor for a friend, then 350 weddings (coming soon)
- 006: "The LUMIX S1 II" — Fifteen years of buying cameras, and the one he stopped switching from (coming soon)
- 007: "Fourth place" — A Dance Dance Revolution couples sync tournament, before the wedding and the kids (coming soon)

Notes index: https://www.tone.dad/notes
